observations: No new photos were provided after the seller’s reply.
Photo 0 remains the only visual evidence: a commuter/road-style adult bicycle with front suspension fork, headlight, and fender.
From photo 0, brakes and gear operation are not shown in close-up, and rust/wear cannot be confirmed at component level.

claims.claim: No o, I tested it myself yesterday, everything I said is true.
claims.evidence: Seller text only; no new photos/videos to verify the test results.
Photo 0 does not show close-ups of shifters/derailleur or brake components, and no braking/shifting video is provided.
Photo 0 is too wide to confirm fine rust/corrosion on chain, cassette/freewheel, spokes, and brake hardware.
No component markings/serials or close-ups to verify originality.
No close-ups of wear points (tires, chain stretch, wheel alignment, brake pads/rotors/drums) are provided.

risks.risk: Brakes may not perform well under load (pads/rotors/drums worn or contaminated) even if they look okay.
risks.proof: Short video of hard braking from a safe rolling test + close-up photos of front and rear brake areas (pads/rotors/drums).
risks.if_unproven: Price as if brakes need service (worst case: not fully working).

risks.risk: Gears may shift poorly (misadjusted derailleur, worn chain/cassette/freewheel) even if the seller claims they are perfect.
risks.proof: Video showing shifting through all gears (front and rear if applicable) with clear derailleur movement + close-up of rear derailleur and shifter.
risks.if_unproven: Price as if gears are not perfect (worst case: needs adjustment/possible chain/cassette wear).

risks.risk: Hidden rust/corrosion on chain, cassette/freewheel, spokes, bottom bracket, and brake hardware.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of chain and cassette/freewheel area plus spoke nipples and any rust-prone joints.
risks.if_unproven: Price as if corrosion may require cleaning/replacement (worst case: parts may need replacement).

risks.risk: Tire condition and wheel alignment/wobble not verifiable from one wide shot.
risks.proof: Photos of both wheels straight-on and a short rolling video showing wobble; close-up of tire sidewalls and tread.
risks.if_unproven: Price as if tires/alignment may need work (worst case: tire replacement).

risks.risk: Exact model/size/spec unknown, affecting Lagos resale value.
risks.proof: Photo of frame/model label/serial number and a full side profile showing size/geometry cues.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic used adult bicycle with unknown specs (worst case: lower value).

proof_requests: Send close-up photos: front brake area, rear brake area, rear derailleur + shifter, chain/cassette/freewheel, and both wheel hubs/spokes.
Send a short video: bike being ridden/rolled while shifting through all gears and braking hard safely.
Send a photo of any frame/model label or serial number and a full side view showing wheel size/overall condition.
response.reason: The seller’s claim of testing is not verifiable without the decisive evidence (close-ups and a shifting/braking video). With only photo 0, key value drivers remain uncertain, so pricing confidently isn’t possible.
